query: What are the common advantage attributes of airlines whose overall rating is high?

per_column.name: cabin_crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Service quality delivered by cabin crew is a genuine constitutive aspect of an airline's competitive advantage in the passenger-experience dimension.

per_column.name: aircraft_cleanliness_maintenance
per_column.rationale: Cabin cleanliness and maintenance is an aspect of the product/hardware experience an airline offers, a legitimate part-of the advantage concept.

per_column.name: aircraft_modernity
per_column.rationale: Fleet modernity is a facet of the airline's physical product offering; however it overlaps materially with cleanliness_maintenance since the dominant value 'well_maintained_modern' blends the two aspects.

per_column.name: ground_service_efficiency
per_column.rationale: Ground/airport service efficiency (check-in, boarding) is a distinct constitutive aspect of the end-to-end service advantage.

per_column.name: fare_value_proposition
per_column.rationale: Price/value proposition is a core facet of competitive advantage and does not overlap with the service or product facets.

judge.rationale: All five columns are true meronymic facets of airline competitive advantage rather than external predictors, causes, or restatements, so the part-of requirement is met. Mutual exclusivity is lowered by the substantial conceptual and empirical overlap between aircraft_cleanliness_maintenance and aircraft_modernity: both target the physical aircraft/hardware aspect and their top values ('well_maintained_modern', 'clean_well_maintained') conflate cleanliness with modernity, so they do not cleanly carve non-overlapping aspects. Exhaustiveness is moderate: the set covers crew service, physical product (two overlapping facets), ground service, and price/value, but omits salient constitutive facets such as seat comfort/legroom, food & beverage quality, inflight entertainment/connectivity, and network/schedule/reliability (punctuality) — several of which are prominent advantage aspects and are even present as original columns. The set is coherent but skews toward hardware and under-covers the in-flight comfort and operational-reliability dimensions of the concept.
